purpose: Who owns which slice. Claim in a PR. One owner per feature.

features.name: Voxide start/stop
features.verification: Voice starts and stops the practice timer

features.name: Transcript after stop
features.verification: Stopping practice shows the spoken transcript

features.name: Pull citations from speech
features.verification: Cited names, years, or titles from the talk appear as a list

features.name: Scholarxiv found / not found
features.verification: Citations from the talk and from manuscript prep are in corpus, not found, or unverified — never invented

features.name: Say it like this
features.verification: Spoken debrief: keep one, fix two, one replacement line; if a manuscript was pasted, also flag speech vs their paper

features.name: Viva questions + second take
features.verification: Two spoken examiner questions from Scholarxiv hits (or their abstract if none); user can start a second take

features.name: Language + spoken errors
features.verification: English plus one local language if tested; mic/API failures are spoken

features.name: Scholarxiv ideation + changelogs
features.verification: Ideation trail on Scholarxiv; CHANGELOG and STARK notes stay current

features.name: Manuscript prep (read first)
features.verification: User pastes title, question, abstract, up to 5 refs; examiner pack is ready before the mic. Open talk still works with no paste. No full-PDF pipeline.
